name: itx-analytics
description: Ask Claude about your site's traffic. Connects to the ITX Analytics MCP endpoint on your WordPress site and adds analysis skills.

mcp_url.title: ITX Analytics MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: From WordPress → ITX Analytics → Settings → Connect an AI assistant. Looks like https://your-site.com/wp-json/itx-analytics/v1/mcp/key

access_key.title: Access key
access_key.description: The Basic value shown once when you create an access key on the same settings card (a WordPress application password, base64 of login:password).
